rules.undefined_intervals: Unavailable if fewer than 95% of bootstrap draws are defined.
rules.binomial_intervals: Wilson 95%, descriptive only. Repeats, claims and retrieval arms are dependent.
rules.interpretation: No automatic adoption, human truth, unsupported-claim detection, causal speedup or B historical latency claim.
